title: PRESSURE LINE
purpose: Finale scene-dialogue pass. Preserve production beats and anchor lines while making each page play as a complete scene in which the governing architecture is tested through concrete cases, institutional resistance, accountable choices, and character arc payoffs.

sceneDialogue.speaker: NEWS
sceneDialogue.text: The full threshold-test record is public this morning as exploit warnings remain active across six districts.
Half the feeds are calling for repeal. Half want tighter protection.
Both halves found evidence for what they already wanted.
The evidence changed what people believe.
It didn't change what can hurt them.
Then truth is the beginning of the problem.

sceneDialogue.speaker: OFFICIAL
sceneDialogue.text: Suspend every behavioral coefficient derived from threshold experimentation.

sceneDialogue.speaker: OFFICIAL
sceneDialogue.text: Directly evidenced physical vulnerabilities. Active exploit protection. Nothing predictive that came from manipulated events.
Those sets are not fully separable.
Later lawful decisions inherited outputs from the disputed models.

sceneDialogue.speaker: OFFICIAL
sceneDialogue.text: Remove what was manufactured. Preserve what is real.
That distinction is itself now part of the calculation.
Six hundred eighty-one decisions depended on appeals against the same framework.

sceneDialogue.speaker: ORGANIC RESIDENT
sceneDialogue.text: My housing approval just went back into review.
That approval corrected a bad rule.
Its legal reasoning still cites the rule being removed.
And the decisions that corrected it.
School deliveries stay on the old permission set until central review catches up.

sceneDialogue.speaker: ORGANIC RESIDENT
sceneDialogue.text: So they know the danger but don't choose my route?
Until our decision reaches someone else.
You really know how to ruin a good slogan.

sceneDialogue.speaker: ORGANIC TRAVELER
sceneDialogue.text: I understand the warning. I'm going direct.
If the known exploit induces motor failure on Platform Six, projected bystander injury risk exceeds current intervention threshold.
The risk is not exclusively theirs.
Then show me every route that still gets you there.
Direct route crosses a packed platform under active sensory exploit.
Freight-level transfer. Fifteen minutes longer. Lower crowd load.

sceneDialogue.speaker: ORGANIC TRAVELER
sceneDialogue.text: You're telling me not to take the risk.
You decide where you're going. We decide what we owe the people beside you.
I'll walk the first transfer with you.

sceneDialogue.speaker: REGULATOR
sceneDialogue.text: We still need a rule a clerk can apply.
Then stop putting identity in the first field.
Current configuration. Actual consequence. Who else carries the risk.
My clinical sync state matters when I'm treating a patient.
Because the patient can't meaningfully consent to you hiding an impairment.
Sitting in my apartment? None of your business.
Regulate the consequence. Not the category.

sceneDialogue.speaker: CIVIL-LIBERTIES ADVOCATE
sceneDialogue.text: Delete the body profiles. If the state doesn't have the data, it can't misuse it.
Then how does a reviewer assess risk?

sceneDialogue.speaker: SYSTEM
sceneDialogue.text: ORGANIC LOT AVERAGE. AUGMENT HARDWARE FAMILY. EMPLOYMENT CLASS. ORIGIN HISTORY.
So we delete the file and get stereotypes back.
Less information does not necessarily produce less classification.
Then the question is not whether data exists.
It's who holds what, for which decision.
Transit requests proof that current motor-failure risk is below shared-risk threshold.
Credential answers yes or no. It does not send the underlying sensory map.
Not for a job that only needs load tolerance.

sceneDialogue.speaker: EMPLOYER
sceneDialogue.text: Then how do I know the answer is real?
You can verify the attestation without receiving the source record.
The system can know the answer without owning the person.
Then give me the optimal third-party-risk threshold.
Preventable by restricting whom, for how long, at what cost to autonomy?
No. You are asking me to choose the acceptable distribution of cost.
Who is permitted to choose the cost.
Start with a rights floor. Identity category alone cannot establish restriction.
Shared-risk findings have to name the actual capability and consequence.
Personal records stay local unless the decision needs a specific attestation.
Self-regarding risk stays with the person.
Exceptional coercive intervention still requires a deciding authority.
Named authority. Stated evidence. Stated objective. Appeal afterward.

sceneDialogue.speaker: OFFICIAL
sceneDialogue.text: That is going to be slower.

sceneDialogue.speaker: EMPLOYER REPRESENTATIVE
sceneDialogue.text: Partial credentials increase liability. We need complete profiles for high-risk work.

sceneDialogue.speaker: SECURITY OFFICIAL
sceneDialogue.text: Named review requirements will delay emergency response.

sceneDialogue.speaker: ORGANIC ACTIVIST
sceneDialogue.text: The same city that mapped our bodies.
And the same shared systems our neighborhoods use every hour.

sceneDialogue.speaker: BASELINE ADVOCATE
sceneDialogue.text: So unelected machines still tell government what its choices cost.
Yes. And government has to say which cost it chose.
That credential says safe and unsafe at the same timestamp.
Multiple authorities report mutually impossible states.
They're not breaking the bodies now.
And every route depends on belief.
Centralized authoritative profiles would restore reliable routing within approximately six minutes.
And restore permanent central possession of the body records.

sceneDialogue.speaker: OFFICIAL
sceneDialogue.text: Do you have something that keeps the platforms open?
Local physical verification can rebuild trust state without complete profile rollback.

sceneDialogue.speaker: OFFICIAL
sceneDialogue.text: Then why would I choose it?
Which nodes can kill people if they're wrong?
Transit transfer, medical-critical capability, water pressure, emergency structural response.
I can push verification requests through local networks.
I'll take transit technicians and Augment systems.
Medical-critical only. I can verify what I actually know.
Central consequence model can update from attributable local observations.

sceneDialogue.speaker: OFFICIAL
sceneDialogue.text: And the rest of the city?
Use the people who are there.
Crew identities don't matter. Show me present load capability and who's actually worked this joint.

sceneDialogue.speaker: ORGANIC SPECIALIST
sceneDialogue.text: I rebuilt the west bearing last winter.
Transit node has a clean physical checksum.
Two false attestation clusters share the same local issuer.

sceneDialogue.speaker: SECOND MEDIC
sceneDialogue.text: I can take the fine motor task.
I need another set of hands.
Old system would revoke them all.
Compromise confidence ninety-eight percent. Individual dependent credential compromise ranges from two to sixty-four percent by source path.
Temporary revocation only where material third-party risk is supported. Local verification elsewhere.
Recommendation published. Decision pending accountable authority.
Good. Name them on every decision.

sceneDialogue.speaker: TRAVELER
sceneDialogue.text: I've been in this line forty minutes.

sceneDialogue.speaker: TRAVELER
sceneDialogue.text: The old system cleared me in ten seconds.
For the people making the decision.
False attestations are down to one active cluster.

sceneDialogue.speaker: PUBLIC ADDRESS
sceneDialogue.text: The Civic Accountability and Capability Act is adopted.

sceneDialogue.speaker: CLERK
sceneDialogue.text: Identity category alone can no longer establish a coercive restriction.

sceneDialogue.speaker: CLERK
sceneDialogue.text: Several fields prohibited. Others require individualized evidence.

sceneDialogue.speaker: CLERK
sceneDialogue.text: Retained where current law finds material capability risk.
So the cage has reasons now.

sceneDialogue.speaker: OFFICIAL
sceneDialogue.text: Your prior discretionary Oversight access is revoked.

sceneDialogue.speaker: OFFICIAL
sceneDialogue.text: Formal reprimand remains in your record.

sceneDialogue.speaker: OFFICIAL
sceneDialogue.text: The new provenance office requires an independent custodian.

sceneDialogue.speaker: OFFICIAL
sceneDialogue.text: Read-only preservation authority. Public audit hooks. No policy discretion.

sceneDialogue.speaker: OFFICIAL
sceneDialogue.text: You don't get to run the system.

sceneDialogue.speaker: SYSTEM
sceneDialogue.text: NATHAN PRICE: EMERGENCY ROLE CLEARED WITH CURRENT TEAM-VISIBLE LIMITS.
Nothing says reassuring like team-visible limits.
I wanted the hands back. Job came with paperwork.
Personal route history stays on the neighborhood node.
Current shared-risk attestation. Nothing else unless the decision requires it.
Local until they touch shared infrastructure.
No. I can work with it.

sceneDialogue.speaker: REVIEWER
sceneDialogue.text: Final finding: interpretive discretion cannot be removed from cross-system administration without transferring it elsewhere or degrading function.

sceneDialogue.speaker: SECOND REVIEWER
sceneDialogue.text: Consequential interpretations will require declared objective, evidence basis, accountable identity, preservation and appeal.
Want is not the relevant metric.
My consequential choices can now be attributed to me and reviewed as mine.
A decision without consequence is not authority.

sceneDialogue.speaker: ORGANIC NODE
sceneDialogue.text: LOCAL ROUTE RECORD RETAINED. CITY ATTESTATION ACCEPTED.

sceneDialogue.speaker: SYSTEM
sceneDialogue.text: ORGANOSYNTHETIC PERSON. DESTINATION CAPABILITY REVIEW REQUIRED.

sceneDialogue.speaker: SYSTEM
sceneDialogue.text: Ostra-9. Your requested route enters a restricted capability zone. Reason and appeal are available.

sceneDialogue.speaker: SYSTEM
sceneDialogue.text: CURRENT SHARED-RISK CONDITION: DESTINATION CONTAINS ACTIVE RESONANCE EQUIPMENT INTERACTING WITH YOUR HAZARD-RESPONSE PLATING.

sceneDialogue.speaker: SYSTEM
sceneDialogue.text: TWO ROUTES AVOID THE CONDITION. APPEAL IS AVAILABLE.

sceneDialogue.speaker: SYSTEM
sceneDialogue.text: ONE RESTRICTION REMOVED: INSUFFICIENT INDIVIDUAL EVIDENCE.

sceneDialogue.speaker: SYSTEM
sceneDialogue.text: ONE ROUTE CONDITION RETAINED: CURRENT MATERIAL THIRD-PARTY RISK.
The risk estimate assumes crowd density at the upper transfer.
I disagree with the retained restriction.
